reasoning_content: Git status is clean (no modified files, and node_modules and dist should be gitignored — let's check .gitignore). I'll use another method to check the ports.

action.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---PORTS---"; for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do [ -f "$f" ] && awk 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {split($2,a,":"); printf "%d\n", ("0x" a[2])+0}' "$f"; done | sort -un

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo \"---PORTS---\"; for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do [ -f \"$f\" ] && awk 'NR>1 && $4==\"0A\" {split($2,a,\":\"); printf \"%d\\n\", (\"0x\" a[2])+0}' \"$f\"; done | sort -un", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Show gitignore and listening ports from /proc"}

summary: Show gitignore and listening ports from /proc
